name.full: Manfred Siew - Aerospace Engineering & Software Development

description.short: Portfolio: work, projects and experience of Manfred Siew.
description.full:
The portfolio of Manfred Siew, trained in Aerospace Engineering and self-taught in software development, currently a Forward Deployed Solution Architect (Intern) at RAiD (RSAF Agile innovation Digital).

This app pins the portfolio into Teams as a personal tab, with four pages:

- Home - introduction, featured work and a snapshot of skills and tools.
- Work - the professional track record, role by role.
- Projects - the build log: simulation and decision support, scaling systems, enterprise applications, process automation, developer enablement and R&D, competitions and credentials.
- Experience - education, certifications and the wider background.

The app is read-only. It presents published portfolio content and nothing else: it requests no permissions, reads no Teams or organisational data, signs nobody in, and stores nothing about the viewer.
